title: Original-DOS move-order fixture
description: One move order run through the executed routines as the player gives it (demo: reach search 0b06:0331, order code 10cc:02dd with the end-cell check 10cc:0f74 and the path search 0b06:0e12, move start 10cc:05c3, then the step 10cc:071e once per main-loop call until the arrival, the plain move of 10cc:0ae2). The map fields are those of movement-fixture.schema.json; numbers only, unit types and terrain index the build's records in the "move" tables of its dosrules profile (internal/dosrules/demo.json). Every placed unit's container record (live +0x0a) is record 0, with empty slots.

units.description: Units on the moving side's own map.

unseen.description: Units on the other side's map only.

retarget.description: Cell the order's destination is changed to between the order code and the start; -1 none.

stale.description: Cells whose reach bit for the side is set before the reach search (left from an earlier query; the search ORs its bits into the array).

order.description: AX of the order code: 1 accepted, 9 accepted for a two-cell ship, 0x12 refused (0x1a for a ship).

start.description: AX of the move start; 0 where the order code refused, 0x12 where the destination changed since.

messages.description: [code, side] of every status message shown: an end code (0x37, 0x39, 0x40) or 0x48 (no path) on refusal, 0x38 on arrival.

cells.description: The mover's cell as its side sees it after each step; the last is the destination.

live.description: The 26 bytes of every placed unit's live record afterwards.

occupants.description: [cell, unit index] of every occupied cell of the side's map and of the other side's map afterwards; terrain bytes are unchanged.

bits.description: [row * 64 + column, value] of every non-zero byte of the bit array afterwards: reach bits 1/2 (side 0/1), moved bits 0x10/0x20.

container.description: Container record 0 afterwards (0x1c bytes: seven slots per side, +0x0e the position).
